title: airgap: kubelet provisioning + OCI registry mirroring + reproducible delta bundles
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: customers running fully air-gapped Private deployments reported two recurring pain points: (1) manual kubelet/node provisioning steps that vary by distro, and (2) brittle offline registry mirroring that broke during incremental upgrades. This PR delivers: 1) a cross-distro kubelet provisioning helper that generates systemd unit snippets + containerd mirror configs from the airgap catalog and injects them into the node bootstrap bundle; 2) an OCI registry mirror manifest generator that produces deterministic image manifest lists and mirror index files so mirror replication can be validated offline; 3) a reproducible delta-bundle generator that emits compact binary diffs between runtime release bundles to reduce s3/usb transfer sizes and speed upgrades in low-bandwidth datacenters; 4) an upgrade/rollback hook that stages kubelet config changes and can atomically swap systemd unit drop-ins to avoid mid-upgrade kubelet restarts. Changes are guarded behind the new installer flag --airgap-kubelet-mirror. Backwards compatibility: installers that don't enable the flag see no change in bundle layout. Safety: all generated artifacts are signed with the installer GPG key and the installer now emits a verification manifest with sha256 sums of each artifact. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for manifest generator - [x] integration smoke test with k3s and rke2 bundles - [x] installer e2e in airgapped CI matrix - [x] upgrade/rollback scenario tested on VM lab. Known limitations: kubelet helper currently supports systemd-based distros (Ubuntu/Fedora/RHEL/CentOS/Alma) and containerd; non-systemd distros will fallback to a documented manual step. See ENG-4783 for next steps (non-systemd support, Windows nodes). Deployment notes: operators must add the generated mirror index to their private registry seed; rollback is automatic only if the generated delta patch applies cleanly. Links: runway doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4783/airgap-kubelet-mirroring, internal S3 bucket path s3://airgap-builds/delta/2024-10-12/.

b2c3d4e: mirror: produce OCI mirror-index.json with deterministic ordering and timestamps truncated
c3d4e5f: delta: implement binary delta emitter using xdelta3 with reproducible metadata

review_comments: Ethan Park: The deterministic ordering in mirror-index looks good, but can you add an explicit 'build_epoch' field so downstream validators can detect reproducible builds?
Maya Chen (author): Added build_epoch as an int64 to mirror_index and updated verification manifest; kept timestamp truncation to seconds to avoid drift during replication.
Sorana Ionescu: Delta generator is a great improvement — can we ensure xdelta is bundled for Alpine? The CI runner failed on musl yesterday.
Maya Chen: Bundled a static xdelta3 in packaging/xdelta and added a small wrapper that picks the right binary for distro; CI matrix now runs alpine and debian nodes.
Diego Ramos: Concern: swapping systemd drop-ins could cause short node downtime if kubelet restarts. Add a canary swap mode and a fallback to previous drop-in on failure.

Maya Chen: Implemented staged-swap mode using atomic directory moves and a verification probe that waits for node Ready before committing; rollback path added that re-applies previous drop-in and restarts kubelet only if probe fails.
Ethan Park: Please include a short upgrade note in release notes about the new --airgap-kubelet-mirror flag and the required step to seed private registries.
Maya Chen: Added release notes and a short section in docs/airgap/kubelet-mirroring.md.
CI Bot: airgap/upgrade-e2e flaky on rke2-1.23 matrix; retried and passed on second run.
merge_outcome: Merged by sorana-merge-bot via squash; commit message: 'airgap: kubelet provisioning + OCI mirroring + reproducible delta bundles (ENG-4783)'.
release_notes: Airgapped installer: add --airgap-kubelet-mirror to generate kubelet systemd drop-ins and containerd mirror configs; produce deterministic OCI mirror-index files; produce signed reproducible delta bundles to reduce upgrade transfer size; staged swap + rollback support for kubelet unit changes. See docs/airgap/kubelet-mirroring.md for operator steps.
notes_for_ops: Operators must import packaging/airgap/signing/example.pub into their verification keyring and add the generated mirror-index.json to their private registry seed. For upgrades, prefer the delta bundle path to reduce transfer times; fallback to full bundle if delta apply fails. The installer will emit a verification-manifest.json alongside artifacts.
test_summary: Unit tests cover mirror index parsing and delta checksum verification. Integration e2e ran in airgapped CI against k3s and rke2 using VM lab; upgrade+rollback scenarios validated with a simulated 128kbps throttled link.
